    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AnsiUtils
    Utility class for terminal string manipulation that is aware of ANSI escape codes.
    Board
    Represents the game board containing all shared resources and cards.
    BotStrategy
    Stateless AI strategy for CPU-controlled players.
    Card
    Represents a development card that players can purchase.
    CardLoader
    Facade for loading card and noble data into the game.
    CardRenderer
    Renders a single development Card as an 8-line ASCII art box for display in the terminal.
    ClientHandler
    Handles communication with a single network client.
    Colors
    Centralized ANSI color constants and colorization utilities for terminal output.
    ComputerPlayer
    An AI-controlled player in the Splendor game.
    ConfigException
    Exception thrown when configuration operations fail.
    ConfigKeys
    Constants for configuration property keys.
    ConfigValidator
    Performs fail-fast validation of game configuration and data files.
    ConsoleView
    Console-based implementation of IGameView.
    CsvCardParser
    Parses card and noble data from a CSV file.
    DataLoadException
    Exception indicating a failure during card or noble data loading operations.
    FileConfigProvider
    Production implementation of IConfigProvider that loads configuration from a properties file located in the classpath resources.
    Game
    Represents the complete game state and coordinates all game components.
    GameController
    Central orchestrator for the Splendor board game.
    GameLogger
    Centralized logging facility for the Splendor game application.
    GameRenderer
    Responsible for composing and printing the full terminal game screen.
    GameRuleValidator
    Validates game-level rules and state transitions.
    GameState
    Represents the current phase of a Splendor game's lifecycle.
    GameStateException
    Exception indicating an operation was attempted in an invalid game state.
    Gem
    Represents the gem types in Splendor.
    IConfigProvider
    Contract for configuration providers in the Splendor game.
    IGameView
    Contract for all view implementations in the Splendor game's MVC architecture.
    InputResolver
    Robust input parsing and validation utility for console-based user interaction.
    InsufficientTokensException
    Exception indicating a player does not have enough tokens for an action.
    InvalidMoveException
    Exception indicating a move violates the rules of Splendor.
    InvalidPlayerActionException
    Exception indicating a player action is not permitted in the current context.
    Main
    Application entry point that handles mode selection and initialization.
    MenuAction
    Enumerates the distinct actions a player can select from the main action menu.
    MenuBuilder
    Stateless factory that constructs the ordered list of MenuOption objects presented to a player at the start of their turn.
    MenuOption
    An immutable data object that describes a single entry in the player's action menu.
    Move
    Represents a move made by a player during their turn.
    MoveFormatter
    Utility class that converts a completed Move into a compact, human-readable string suitable for display in the scrolling move-history panel.
    MoveType
    Enumeration of all possible move types a player can execute during their turn.
    MoveValidator
    Validates whether proposed moves obey Splendor rules.
    NetworkException
    Exception indicating a failure during network operations in multiplayer mode.
    NetworkGameView
    Implements IGameView for a network game with one RemoteView per player.
    NetworkMessageHandler
    Abstraction over the network transport used by remote views.
    Noble
    Represents a noble tile that provides victory points.
    Player
    Represents a player in the game, tracking their resources and progress.
    PlayerController
    Manages player-specific operations and state updates.
    RemoteView
    Network-based implementation of IGameView for remote clients.
    ServerSocketHandler
    Network server that handles remote client connections.
    SplendorException
    Root exception class for all Splendor game-specific exceptions.
    TurnController
    Manages turn execution and move processing.
    ValidationResult
    Immutable value object that carries the outcome of a rule-explanation check.
